summary:
TerraTrend – Intelligent Earth Change Detection & Analysis Platform

TerraTrend is an interactive Earth science data analysis platform designed to identify, visualize, and analyze environmental changes across different geographical regions over time. It enables users to explore Earth science variables such as temperature, precipitation, sea level, soil moisture, and vegetation using satellite observations and scientific datasets. The platform provides interactive time-series graphs, geographical visualizations, and regional comparisons to identify increasing and decreasing trends. It incorporates statistical techniques to measure the magnitude and rate of change and determine whether observed trends are statistically significant. By transforming complex Earth science data into clear, meaningful insights, TerraTrend helps researchers understand what is changing, where changes are occurring, and how significant they are. This supports better environmental monitoring, climate research, and data-driven decision-making for protecting our planet.
details:
Our project is an AI-powered NASA Data Analysis Platform designed to transform complex space-related datasets into meaningful insights. It collects and analyzes NASA data, identifies hidden patterns, detects unusual activities, and presents results through interactive dashboards and visualizations. Users can explore space data, monitor important trends, and receive AI-generated insights and predictions.

The platform helps simplify space research, reduces manual data analysis, improves decision-making, and makes scientific information more accessible. Its intended impact is to support researchers, students, and space enthusiasts in understanding space-related phenomena and discovering valuable insights.

We developed the project using Python, JavaScript, React.js, HTML, CSS, AI/ML technologies, NASA APIs, and Vercel for deployment. The creative aspect is the integration of AI-powered analysis, interactive visualizations, and intelligent insights into a single platform.

Our team considered important factors such as data accuracy, reliability, scalability, performance, user-friendly design, accessibility, and real-world usefulness. Our ultimate goal is to make NASA data analysis smarter, faster, and more accessible while contributing to future space research and exploration.
